question: How wide should the catchment be, and do the marks a wider one admits really belong to the line the returns assign them to?

inputs.role: flight-line tracks; used for the SEARCH and to measure the local line spacing

params.name: half_widths_m
params.why: the two candidate catchments being compared; the narrow one is half the measured line spacing (the class-12 seam), the wide one is a bound that lets the RETURNS do the discriminating

params.name: collinear_sigma
params.why: passes merged into physical lines within this many prediction-sd

columns.pair: adjacent flight lines whose tracks are being separated
columns.spacing_m: perpendicular distance between the two tracks at the site's northing, m
columns.half_spacing_m: half of it -- the class-12 seam, where the vendor cuts bare-earth ground over to the neighbouring line, m
columns.point_id: control mark admitted only by the WIDER catchment
columns.line: point_source_id the RETURNS assign, not the nearest track
columns.dist_to_track_m: perpendicular distance to the nearest searched track, m
columns.dominant_frac: share of ground returns at the mark carrying that line, 0-1; how decisively the returns place it
columns.n_lines_at_mark: distinct point_source_id values in the mark's window, count

headline: seam 462-506 m; the wider catchment adds 4 marks
